title: Fenerbahce outlast Anadolu Efes in overtime, clinch BSL title
description: Fenerbahce - Anadolu Efes 80-72 (OT) Fenerbahce are crowned 23/24 BSL champions. They outscored Anadolu Efes in overtime in Game 4 of the Finals to conquer the title. Nigel Hayes-Davis (203-F-1994, college: Wisconsin) finished with 16 points to pace the winners. Fenerbahce grabbed a comfortable 22-8 lead after ten minutes. But Anadolu Efes responded with a 25-14 run in the second stanza to pull within 3 points. The visitors held Fenerbahce to 15 points in the third quarter to eke out a single-point lead. But Fenerbahce limited their opponents to just 12 points in the final term as Nigel Hayes-Davis sent the game into overtime. The hosts poured in 16 points in the extra period and got away with the crucial win. Scottie Wilbekin (188-G-1993, college: Florida) produced 12 points for the champions.
